correctness.rationale: PASS: For p=2q+1 with q odd prime, all nonzero quadratic nonresidues are primitive except the order-two element −1; the exact indicator (1−χ(x))/2−1_{x=−1} gives 2S=Σ_{x≠0}χ(Q(x))−T−2χ(Q(−1)). Standard separable quadratic character sum equals −χ(a), including linear a=0 via χ(0)=0; subtract χ(c), giving S and N± from primitive root count (p−3)/2. When ac≠0, E:y²=xQ(x) is nonsingular elliptic and contains rational 2-torsion (0,0), so even integer trace obeys |T|≤2 floor sqrt(p) by Hasse. For ac=0, a simple quadratic-character sum gives T=−χ(b). Therefore |S|≤floor sqrt p+2 and Nε≥(p−11−2floor sqrt p)/4>0 for p≥23. Finite exact independently enumerated normalized polynomials p23,p47 and witnesses, plus p7,p11. The p5 q-even case is explicitly excluded from exact formula but included as small-prime obstruction; no extrapolation from the finite cases.
